_comment: Test-only config of the in-core offline capability (its keys are declared by the capability's configSchema in @geoleaf/core; config/plugins/ files are skipped by validate-profiles). Carries cache.{enableProfileCache,enableTileCache} = false (NON-default). enableProfileCache proves a profile override survives the core spread default (ANO-078). enableTileCache no longer goes through a spread at all: the engine now reads it directly (ResourceEnumerator._tilesRequested) as a VETO, and this profile is the only one in the repo that sets it to false — it is what makes the veto observable. SW/offline moved to modules.pwa (S14).
